m: महा—लीला-सरस्वती f. a form of the goddess Tārā q.v., Tantras.

s: strI, (lIlayA sarasvatI । mahatI lIlasarasvatIti karmmaDArayaH .) tArAviSezaH । “lIlayA vAkpradA ceti tena lIlasarasvatI । tArAstrarahitA tryarRA mahAlIlasarasvatI ॥” iti tantrasAraH ॥

strI, (mahatI lakzmoH .) rADA । nArAyaRaSaktiH । yaTA, -- “yanmAyayA mohitASca brahmavizRuSivAdayaH । vEzRavAstAM mahAlakzmIM parAM rADAM vadanti te ॥ yadardDANgA mahAlakzmIH priyA nArAyaRasya ca ॥” iti brahmavEvartte prakftiKaRqe 51 aDyAyaH ॥ aTa mahAlakzmImantraH । “tAro vAgBavaM mAyA ramAkAmaH hasOrjjagatprasUtyE namaH ॥” taTA ca । “vAgBavaM SamBuvanitA ramA makaraketanaH । tArttIyaYca jagatpArSvo vahnibIjasamujjvalaH ॥ arGISAQyo BfgustyEhfmmantro'yaM dvAdaSAkzaraH । mahAlakzmyAH samuddizwastArAdyaH sarvvasidDidaH ॥” tasyA DyAnaM yaTA, tantrasAre । “bAlArkadyutiminduKaRqavilasatkowIrahArojjvalAM ratnAkalpaviBUzitAM kucanatAM SAleH karErmmaYjarIm । padmO kOstuBaratnamapyavirataM saMbiBratIM sasmitAM PullAmBojavilocanatrayayutAM DyAyet parAmambikAm ॥” (asyA bIjam । o~ E~ hnI~ SrI~ klI~ hsO~ jagatprasUtyE namaH .)
v: strI karma॰ । caRqyAdvitIyacaritadevatArUpe “seze sEriBamardinImiha mahAlakzmIM sarojasTitAm” ityuktalakzaRe azwAdaSaBujAnvite 1 durgASaktiBede tantrokte 2 lakzmIBede ca ।
m: महा—लक्ष्मी f. the gr˚ Lakṣmī (properly the Śakti of Nārāyaṇa or Viṣṇu, but sometimes identified with Durgā or with Sarasvatī; also N. of Dākṣāyaṇī in Kara-vīra), Pañcar.; Kathās. (cf. RTL. 385)
N. of a girl 13 years old and not arrived at puberty (who represents the goddess Durgā at the D˚ festival), L.

महा˚लसा (˚हाल्˚), f. ‘very lazy’, N. of a woman, Cat.
महा—˚लया f. N. of a partic. festival, the day of the moon's change in the month Bhādra and the last day of the Hindū lunar year, Col.

s: puM, (mahatAM jEnAnAmAlayaH । mahAn Alaya iti vA .) vihAraH । (mahatAM yogipraBftInAmAlayaH .) tIrTaH । (mahadAdInAM layo yasmin .) paramAtmA । iti medinI । ye, 125 ॥ sOrASvinIyakfzRapakzaH । yaTA, Bavizye । “yeyaM dIpAnvitA rAjan ! KyAtA paYcadaSI Buvi । tasyAM dadyAnna ceddattaM pitFRAM vE mahAlaye ॥” mahAlaye kanyAgatAparapakze । iti tiTyAditattvam ॥

m: महा˚लय (˚हाल्˚), m. a great dwelling, MW.
a gr˚ temple, gr˚ monastery, ib.
a place of refuge, sanctuary, asylum, W.
the Loka or world of Brahmā, W.
a tree &c. sacred to a deity, W.
